name: blindoracle
description: Ask Claude whether an AI agent is safe to pay. Free trust badge and reputation lookup for any agent (5 a day, no wallet, no account), the live price list for BlindOracle's research, security-audit and due-diligence services, key-free receipt verification, and a proof-of-delegation skill for recording a task handed to another agent as a signed four-step chain. Paid services quote their price before any charge; nothing here moves funds.
